alternatives_considered: UTC Calendar Day (00:00 to 24:00 UTC; 30 days; 87.5% overlap); Shifted window including incomplete Day 30 (21 hours); Boundary imputation of out-of-window hours
scientific_justification: Pairs identical 24-hour physical observation intervals (100% temporal overlap) between cloud regimes and rain-gauge accumulation. Eliminates 3-hour diurnal phase offset. Cleanly excludes incomplete Day 30 (21h) and orphan 3h of Day 1 to avoid incomplete-day bias while retaining 96.67% of the seasonal record without inventing observations.
sensitivity_analysis_plan: Compare primary 29-day exact shifted results against Sensitivity S2 (UTC Calendar Day; 30 days) and Sensitivity S4 (Shifted window including Day 30 at 21h).

selected_primary_choice: Preserve as explicit NaN; strictly ban zero-filling
alternatives_considered: Zero-filling ocean cells; Nearest-neighbor spatial interpolation from land gauges
scientific_justification: Zero-filling ocean cells would invent 629532 spurious dry observations (29 days x 603 cells x 36 seasons) creating artificial associations between marine clouds and extreme drought. Extrapolation across ocean is unphysical.
sensitivity_analysis_plan: None (Zero-filling is strictly prohibited as an inviolable data corruption rule).

selected_primary_choice: Preserve 0.0 mm as valid physical dry observation in all metrics
alternatives_considered: Drop 0.0 mm (wet-days only analysis); Replace with small epsilon (0.01 mm)
scientific_justification: Monsoonal dry spells and break phases are crucial physical characteristics of cloud regimes (e.g. shallow cumulus suppression). Dropping zeros artificially inflates conditional means.
sensitivity_analysis_plan: Report both unconditional metrics (including zeros) and conditional wet-day metrics (R >= 2.5 mm).
governing_policy_or_precedent: M25.4 Data Quality Policy & Standard Hydrometeorology

selected_primary_choice: Spatial Block Bootstrap (3x3 grid blocks x 5-day time blocks) with 1000 iterations
alternatives_considered: Naive two-sample t-tests; Standard one-way ANOVA; I.I.D. permutations
scientific_justification: Daily rainfall exhibits severe spatial autocorrelation (~300 km decorrelation scale) and multi-day temporal persistence. Naive tests yield spurious p < 1e-100 due to false independence.
sensitivity_analysis_plan: Compare naive i.i.d. confidence intervals with spatial block bootstrap confidence intervals to show error inflation.
governing_policy_or_precedent: Physical Spatial Statistics & Climatological Best Practice

selected_primary_choice: Calculate cumulative regime volume contribution C_k = sum(R_k) / sum(R_total)
scientific_justification: A regime with high intensity but low frequency (e.g. R2) may deliver a disproportionately large share of total water budget. Volumetric share provides true hydrological significance.
sensitivity_analysis_plan: Compare volumetric share C_k against temporal frequency share P(R_k).
governing_policy_or_precedent: Hydrological Cloud-Regime Literature (e.g. Rossow et al.)
